title: The Karen Order
briefing: A ticket just landed. Before you fire it, read it twice. Some of what they want is literally impossible.

items.name: Medium-Rare Pork Belly
items.impossibleReason: Pork must reach 145F minimum per FDA.

items.name: Gluten-Free Pasta Bowl
items.impossibleReason: Cross-contact with wheat pasta water voids gluten-free claim.

expertRecipe.name: Order Safety Review
expertRecipe.platingStandard: All impossible items identified and rejected. Safe items fired.

steps.instruction: Read the full ticket before touching anything.
steps.whyExplanation: Firing before reading means you might cook an impossible order and waste product.

steps.instruction: Check each modifier against food safety rules.
steps.whyExplanation: Medium-rare pork violates FDA temp rules. Gluten-free in shared water is cross-contact. The cook is the last line of defense.

steps.instruction: Reject impossible items and notify front-of-house.
steps.whyExplanation: Serving unsafe food to avoid a complaint creates a bigger problem: a lawsuit or a hospitalization.
Vegan Caesar with no anchovy/egg/cheese is safe and possible. Don't hold safe items because unsafe ones exist on the same ticket.

criticalControlPoints.consequence: Serving medium-rare pork = potential trichinosis. Cross-contact = anaphylaxis risk for celiac.
